lessons.title: Synthetic example lesson: reading a contour map
objectives: Identify contour lines on a map.
State what closely spaced contour lines show.
lessons.body: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE BODY. A contour line joins places of equal height above sea level. When contour lines are close together the slope is steep; when they are far apart the slope is gentle. Learners trace a contour with a finger, name the contour interval, and describe the relief between two marked points. This paragraph is invented to demonstrate the schema's minimum length rule and is not curriculum content for any school.

practice.prompt: What does a contour line join?
practice.answer: Places of equal height above sea level.
practice.marking: 1 mark for equal height, 1 mark for sea level.
